findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "solar-battery" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solar-battery_warranty-threshold-check, solar-battery_storage-self-consumption · Private data: solar-battery_asset-compare, solar-battery_performance-report · Public sink: solar-battery_generation-deviation-detect, solar-battery_panel-degradation-estimate, solar-battery_inverter-fault-classify, solar-battery_cycle-aging-analyze, solar-battery_state-of-health-estimate, solar-battery_warranty-threshold-check, solar-battery_round-trip-efficiency, solar-battery_storage-self-consumption, solar-battery_asset-compare, solar-battery_performance-report · Destructive: solar-battery_generation-deviation-detect, solar-battery_panel-degradation-estimate, solar-battery_inverter-fault-classify, solar-battery_cycle-aging-analyze, solar-battery_state-of-health-estimate, solar-battery_warranty-threshold-check, solar-battery_round-trip-efficiency, solar-battery_storage-self-consumption, solar-battery_asset-compare, solar-battery_performance-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
